name: PrintSpool Local - Print Job Management System
description: A comprehensive local-first print job management platform with customer mobile QR workflow, direct local PC transfer, client-side PDF.js print preview with orientation & color verification, recharts print volume & resource telemetry dashboard, queue auto-process instant spooling toggle, DoD 5220.22-M secure shredding with visual toast alerts, Windows PowerShell/Batch installer scripts, and merchant localhost dashboard.
